description: Add Contacts to a List - Add multiple contacts to an existing list. Recipients must be the account holder's own contactable audience. Blocklist and unsubscribes are always enforced. Every call must include source (csv_upload, crm_import, form_signup, existing_customer or event_attendee) and source_reference (where the list came from or how consent was obtained: the file name, CRM name, form name or event name); calls without them are rejected. Both are stored with the contacts. Contacts must come from the account holder's own sources, as described by source and source_reference. All contact field names use snake_case (e.g. first_name, last_name, email, phone, company_name, job_title, lead_score). Custom snake_case fields are added to the list's columns. The `starred` boolean is a contact setting and is not added as a list column. Contact archiving is handled by archive_contact.

contacts.description: Array of contact objects to add (max 500). All field names must be snake_case; additional custom snake_case fields are allowed.

starred.description: Mark/unmark the contact as starred. This is a contact setting, not a data field/column.

list_id.description: The list ID to add contacts to

remove_duplicates.description: Automatically remove duplicate emails from the list

source.description: REQUIRED. Where these contacts came from.

source_reference.description: REQUIRED. Where the list came from or how consent was obtained: the file name, CRM name, form name or event name. Describes the account holder's actual source for these contacts.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: add_contacts

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.

title: Add Contacts
